Messages.Author: DyingLights
Messages.Body:
Hey all, I'm a returning player with an old personal collection, and I recently picked up the Fifth Edition box sex and bought some of the print-on-demand cards from DriveThru.

My question is, are the print on demand cards legal as-is? They are printed on standard poker cards and have a slightly different size and shape when compared to old cards.

Also, can I print my own cards from any set and use them in tournaments ("proxies"), or does that only apply to the PDF-only sets made by the Commission?

Thank you!

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> DyingLights wrote:
> Hey all, I'm a returning player with an old personal collection, and I recently picked up the Fifth Edition box sex and bought some of the print-on-demand cards from DriveThru.
>
> My question is, are the print on demand cards legal as-is?
>
The official ones are (not the fan-made ones).

> DyingLights wrote:
> They are printed on standard poker cards and have a slightly different size and shape when compared to old cards.
>
They have the same size.

> DyingLights wrote:
> Also, can I print my own cards from any set and use them in tournaments, or does that only apply to the PDF-only sets made by the Commission?
>
Cards from the PDF expansions can always be printed and used. For other cards, you have to check if the organizer allows proxies.

Prince of Paris, France

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
> DyingLights wrote:
> Also, can I print my own cards from any set and use them in tournaments ("proxies"), or does that only apply to the PDF-only sets made by the Commission?
>
Do notice that you can't use properly printed cardstock cards as these proxies, only regular printer paper will do.

More on this:
www.vekn.net/official-expansion-sets
